_note: Editor-supplied facts for upcoming briefs. scripts/draft-brief.mjs puts each item whose from–until window includes the brief's date into the draft as an editor note under 'This morning in Waynesville'. Facts here came from the editor and are cleared to use as written (attribute them to the named source). Remove items once their window has passed.

items.text: Today, Saturday, Nov. 28, is Small Business Saturday, the national shop-local day held the Saturday after Thanksgiving (per the editor). Write one or two sentences in Around town encouraging readers to shop and eat at Waynesville's locally owned businesses downtown and along Route 73, and link our business directory (/directory/#shop and /directory/#food). Say hours vary by shop, so check before you go. Do not name specific shops, sales or hours unless a shop's own post says so; no Waynesville merchant event has been announced for today, so do not describe one. Optionally note Christmas in the Village is next weekend, Dec. 4-6. Not a lead item unless the day is otherwise quiet.
